android.desc:
pipipie is a math puzzle game (a.k.a. "the pie") that challenges your arithmetic and logical thinking skills. The goal is to fill the grid with numbers and operators to solve each equation and complete the pie.

Complete the equation in each row and column as fast as possible! Choose your level of difficulty!

How to play:
- Begin by choosing the latest pie by selecting "today's pie" or one of our classics from the "pie archive"
- Choose your preferred difficulty (a.k.a. "flavor")
- You will be presented with the grid and several numbers/operators in the tray
- Items from the tray can be dragged onto the grid
- Each row and column corresponds with an equation that must be solved (BODMAS/PEMDAS rules apply)
- Solve each row and column to add up to the final solution (the purple cell on the bottom right)
- Submit your solution as quickly as possible

Features:
- New pies (games) every day!
- Choose from archived pies created in the last 90 days.
- Check your stats for the last 90 days.
- Beat your best time and build streaks.

quotes.text:
I recently launched a casual math game!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pipipie.game

It's currently only available on Android but I hope to bring it to other platforms soon.

I am a disabled developer who has limited mobility in his arms. I like treating games that are simple and accessible for people just to spend time.

Would love to hear any comments or suggestions!
